operation.description: Lists webhooks for a repository. `last response` may return null if there have not been any deliveries within 30 days.

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

active.description: Determines whether the hook is actually triggered on pushes.

events.description: Determines what events the hook is triggered for. Default: ['push'].

name.description: The name of a valid service, use 'web' for a webhook.

#/components/schemas/webhook-config-cont.description: The media type used to serialize the payloads. Supported values include `json` and `form`. The default is `form`.

oneOf.description: Determines whether the SSL certificate of the host for `url` will be verified when delivering payloads. Supported values include `0` (verification is performed) and `1` (verification is not performed). The default is `0`. **We strongly recommend not setting this to `1` as you are subject to man-in-the-middle and other attacks.**

#/components/schemas/webhook-config-secr.description: If provided, the `secret` will be used as the `key` to generate the HMAC hex digest value for [delivery signature headers](https://docs.github.com/webhooks/event-payloads/#delivery-headers).

#/components/schemas/webhook-config-url.description: The URL to which the payloads will be delivered.
